STEP 1 - Scene: A small snack or side of cut cantaloupe/melon-type fruit pieces (orange flesh, cubed and wedged) on a white plate.

STEP 2 - Vessel: White square-cornered (diamond-oriented) plate, roughly 22 cm across the diagonal corners. Approximate round-equivalent diameter ~20 cm. Area = 3.14 x (10)^2 ≈ 314 cm^2.

STEP 3 - Items: Cut orange melon pieces (cantaloupe-like), about 9 pieces. No visible sauce or oil.

STEP 4 - Area: The pieces cover roughly 20% of the plate in total (pieces are small and spread out with gaps).
- Melon pieces, all together: ~20% = 63 cm^2.

STEP 5 - Volume: Pieces are about 2–2.5 cm high on average. 63 cm^2 x 2.2 cm ≈ 139 ml (gross envelope).

STEP 6 - Grams: Cut fruit bulk density ~0.6 g/ml. 139 ml x 0.6 ≈ 83 g.

STEP 7 - Energy: Cantaloupe ~34 kcal per 100 g. 83 g x 0.34 ≈ 28 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Nine small cubes/wedges of melon, about 80 g, is plausible for a modest fruit portion. Roughly 30 kcal fits the low-calorie nature of melon.

Totals: about 83 g, about 28 kcal.
